title: Chapter 235
text:
Grade C Supers were at the peak of the Blue Star Supers. Their physical resistance was strong, and their destructive power was even stronger. Even in the universe, Grade C was considered the dividing line of the basic forces. It was known as the 'Basic Standard of Planet Exploration Warriors'.

It was not certain that one would reach Grade C at LV 60. It depended on the difference in skills, talents, and attributes. Most of the LV 60 Blue Star Supers were only at Grade D +, and only those like Bennett were at Grade C. In the entire Blue Star, there were only about twenty Grade C Supers.

Han Xiao was at the top of the list.

He was even more confident.

Since he had decided to go to the battlefield, he had to make preparations.

After becoming a [Magnetic Ring Mechanic], his mechanical skills had improved by another level. Han Xiao spent a few days to strengthen his original equipment and build some new machines that might be useful in the future.

However, he did not waste too much time. After all, the Germinal Organization was in a bad situation, and they might turn Aurora into a drug at any time. He had to hurry to save her.

When everything was ready, Han Xiao called Huang Yu over in the evening and said, "I'm going to leave for a while. If there are no accidents, it should be about half a month. During this time, you'll be in charge of the daily affairs of the sanctuary."

I'm the one in charge … Huang Yu did not say this out loud and asked, "Your Excellency, where are you going?"

"Don't ask what you shouldn't." Han Xiao picked up his equipment bag and pretended to leave. "The construction of the sanctuary is on track. Don't make any mistakes. You'll have to bear the consequences yourself."

Huang Yu's heart skipped a beat, and he quickly nodded.

Han Xiao walked out of the room and headed to the helipad. The helicopter was already waiting.

Along the way, he observed the current situation of the sanctuary. There was an endless stream of players, and it was very lively. Other than the construction, the new wanderers also frequently hired players to do some simple work. The prototype of the player's main city was already in his mind.

This time, Han Xiao planned to go alone to save people.

The Six Nations had sealed off the Andrea battlefield. If he approached as a third party, he would be treated as an enemy and attacked. It was not an easy task to get to the battlefield. Han Xiao could not get close by plane like before. He had to go through the official channels to enter the battlefield.

…

In Stardragon's harbor base near the South Continent, three heavy-duty transport planes were doing a pre-takeoff inspection. They were tasked with transporting important supplies across the ocean. In the small square beside the planes, hundreds of people in different outfits were either sitting or standing. They were not wearing Stardragon's military uniform, but they all had the same aura. They were clearly divided into groups, with more and less people, sizing each other up.

These people were mercenaries belonging to different organizations. In such a large-scale war, mercenaries were inevitable, and the Six Nations did not reject the use of mercenaries.

Mercenaries were like hyenas searching for the scent of blood, rushing to various wars to earn rewards. The world was bustling with activity for profit, and the world bustled with activity for profit. Even some of the contract killers of the Blood Pact Society wanted to get involved. Most contract killers were only affiliated with the Dark Net. Strictly speaking, they were not official subordinates and were not under the command of the Dark Net.

There were quite a few Supers among the mercenaries, and they were the strength that the Six Nations desperately needed. One could never have too many Supers. The side with the upper hand in the war would receive help from all over the world, and they could use this help to expand their own advantage. Now, the ground war between the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization was at a stalemate. The super soldiers developed by the Germinal Organization had caused quite a lot of trouble for the Six Nations' ground forces, and they were in need of manpower.

There were thousands of battlefields in Andrea, big and small. The mercenaries were useful in small-scale encounters and to complete some tactical missions. Quality was more important than quantity.

These mercenaries were going to take the transport plane to the mainland of Andrea, and they were chatting with each other. Most of them were boorish men with no discipline and loud voices. The Stardragon soldiers standing guard beside them were irritated, but they were under orders from their superiors and could not scold these mercenaries.

Surrounded by the noisy environment, Qin Yuan crossed his arms, looked around, and said with a playful tone.

"Blade Mercenary Group, Ram Mercenary Group, Ice Sculpture Mercenary Group … Tsk tsk, there are quite a lot of people here. They all want to earn some money from the war. Even the assassins are here to join in the fun. Croll of the Poisonous Bees and Broken Shadow of the Blood Contract are the most famous among the assassins."

Qin Yuan was a slightly famous mercenary, and the mercenary group he belonged to was considered the top level among this group of people, so he received a lot of attention and attention. There were a few others who received the same treatment as him, including Croll and Broken Shadow of the Poisonous Bees. These two assassins also had impressive battle records to prove their strength.

Everyone in the circle knew that the Poisonous Bees and the Blood Pact Society were competitors and enemies, so these two assassins received the most attention. Many mercenaries were waiting to see a good show, but the two of them stood in the corner and were temporarily at peace.

Broken Shadow occasionally looked at Croll with fear in his eyes. Because Croll was more famous, Broken Shadow was very cautious that Croll would do him harm, so he was very cautious.

In comparison, Croll's posture was very relaxed and casual. He closed his eyes to rest, and his face was calm. He did not even look at the crowd and seemed very confident. He ignored Broken Shadow's gaze, and his attitude was somewhat aloof.

Qin Yuan looked at them with interest. Suddenly, he saw the Stardragon soldiers in the distance move aside and let someone walk in.

"Another newcomer." Qin Yuan looked over, and his playful eyes froze. They quickly turned into shock. His mouth opened wide, and he was speechless for a moment.

The others followed his gaze and looked over. The scene that was noisy just a moment ago suddenly seemed to have been sealed by ice. There was silence, and astonishment crawled onto everyone's faces.

A man in black slowly approached and stayed at the edge of the group, but it attracted the attention of everyone in front of him. There were whispers in the crowd.

"Why is someone like him here?"

"Black Phantom, he can represent the Dark Net. Is the Dark Net no longer neutral?"

Han Xiao was not moved. He stood there quietly and did not say a word.

Black Phantom's name was like thunder, and he was a legend of the Dark Net. He immediately stole all the limelight. No one expected someone of this level to work with them.

They were not on the same level at all. Just by standing there, Han Xiao made these mercenaries, who had been so noisy just a moment ago, fall silent. The Stardragon soldiers at the side were amazed. They felt that their ears that had been ravaged finally felt better. They looked at these mercenaries who were so arrogant just a moment ago with ridicule.

Sigh, who asked you to be cocky?

Qin Yuan suddenly realized something and subconsciously looked in the direction of Broken Shadow. Everyone saw it and looked over.

Black Phantom was also a member of the Blood Pact Society.

Broken Shadow did not expect to see a legend of the same organization here. He wanted to go up and talk, but he was afraid that he was not qualified enough to enter Han Xiao's eyes. His eyes were filled with admiration and hesitation. However, Han Xiao's arrival was like a shot in the arm, and it gave him confidence. Broken Shadow stared at Croll fiercely as if he was about to start a fight.

"Damn it, why is he here too?" Croll's back was already wet with cold sweat, and the calmness he had just now was gone. When he saw Broken Shadow's provocative look, he quickly turned around and walked into the crowd, choosing to be an ostrich.

Broken Shadow only felt that he had vented his anger, and his body and mind were refreshed. It was the first time he experienced the feeling of using someone else's power to intimidate others.

The atmosphere was weird, and everyone felt like years. Finally, the plane was ready, and the Stardragon soldiers announced the start of boarding. This group of mercenaries seemed to have discussed it beforehand, and they all moved aside to make a path. At the end of the path was a confused Han Xiao.

"You … ahem, you go first." Qin Yuan coughed, and his tone was respectful.

Wow, this treatment is not bad. Am I that scary? Han Xiao did not know whether to laugh or cry. He shook his head, picked up his equipment bag, and was the first to board the plane under everyone's gazes. He randomly found a seat and sat down. Only then did the others feel relieved and board the plane.

Rumble!

After a while, the plane took off.

Han Xiao's official way to go to Andrea was to choose to become a mercenary of Stardragon. This was the simplest way. The reason why he used the identity of Black Phantom and not a different face was that although the Six Nations accepted mercenaries to participate in the war, they would look at their background and exclude those who were not trustworthy.

His identity as Black Phantom not only had the experience of working together to fight against the Germinal Organization, but he was also a strong member of the Dark Net, so he was very reliable. Of course, using the identity of Black Phantom would have a negative impact on the Dark Net, which had always been neutral, but to Han Technician, this was not a big problem.

In fact, he had another choice, which was to replace the other mercenaries and board the plane secretly. However, he felt that if he could go through the proper channels, he would not cause too much trouble.

Just one word, kiss!

The phone in his pocket vibrated. Han Xiao opened it and saw that it was a call from Bennett.

As soon as he picked up, Bennett's roar shook his eardrums.
